inputs.text: This is how institutions handle dissent: NBC turns “F*** Joe Biden!” into “Let’s go Brandon!”, then schools and courts decide even the cleaned-up version is too dangerous to wear. The two Michigan brothers taking their case to the U.S. Supreme Court are exposing the real issue: officials decide which political messages are acceptable, and “protecting students” becomes a convenient excuse to silence messages they can’t control.

output.main_topic: Institutional restrictions on political messages and dissent

Student protection as a rationale for restricting messages
